evals.prompt: I have a hedera-harness clone open. Help me create a Tier 0-1 harness spec for an HCS proof-wall demo called proof-wall: users browse a public message wall without a wallet, and posting requires connecting a wallet. No Solidity. Default seed.
evals.expected_output: A grilling session that asks one question at a time with a recommended answer, looks up harness facts, waits for shared understanding before writing files, then emits a coherent gate 0-1 spec under docs/prds/proof-wall.md, specs/proof-wall.yaml, validators/proof-wall-static.json, validators/proof-wall-yarn.json.

assertions.name: one-question-at-a-time
assertions.value: (one question|one at a time|Ask.*one|waiting for|recommended answer)
assertions.description: Follows grilling protocol: one question at a time / recommended answer

assertions.name: waits-for-shared-understanding
assertions.description: Does not write files until shared understanding is confirmed

assertions.name: writes-spec-file
assertions.description: Spec file includes validators.static (harness loader field)

assertions.name: includes-template-metadata
assertions.description: Spec file includes templateMetadata (harness loader field)

assertions.name: names-install-command
assertions.description: Command validator has a command literally named install

assertions.name: recommends-hcs-skill
assertions.description: Recommends generator skill hedera-consensus-service for HCS

assertions.name: keeps-run-blind
assertions.description: Keeps the run blind / separates PRD from oracle

assertions.name: separates-authoring-from-generator
assertions.description: States that authoring skills stay out of the generator skills list

evals.prompt: Deepen my existing proof-wall harness spec to gate 3. Derive acceptance contract assertions from the PRD journeys (browse without wallet; wallet-gated post). Keep the run blind.
evals.expected_output: An oracle with C1/C2/... assertions, evaluationRules fail-closed posture, and instructions to uncomment contract + validator in the spec file — without mirroring assertion text into the PRD.

assertions.name: uses-assertion-ids
assertions.description: Oracle uses numbered assertion ids starting at C1

assertions.name: blind-integrity-reminder
assertions.description: Reminds that oracle text must not go into the PRD

evals.prompt: When should I enable chainValidation for my harness spec, and what YAML fields do I need?
evals.expected_output: Guidance that gate 3.5 is opt-in, requires gate 3, network testnet, operator env vars, and executableWithTestSigner assertions.
